Subject: Declaration of Rate of Interest for the Employees’ Provident Fund Members
Account for the year 2013-14 - regarding.

Sir,

It is to Inform that Ministry of Labour and Employment, Govt. of India, vide its letter
No. R-11018/1/2014/SS-II dated 6 March, 2014 has conveyed the approval of the Central
Government under Para 60(1) of Employees’ Provident Funds Scheme, 1952 for crediting interest
@ 8.75% on EPF accumulation for the financial year 2013-14 to the account of each member of
the EPF Scheme.

It is therefore, requested to issue necessary instructions to all concerned for crediting
the interest to the members’ accounts.

Yours faithfully,

4, ,
sansa Eakaany
